title: Weekend Win
text:
## Premise
You're a fresh graduate, just thrown into the harsh reality of job hunting. Days of sending out resumes without any response have turned into a routine. Suddenly, an email arrives - an interview invitation from a bustling city tech company. You're excited, yet nervous, with only three days to prepare.

## The World
The tech world you're stepping into is a vibrant, fast-paced environment. Skyscrapers lined with glass and steel dominate the skyline, their surfaces reflecting the bustling energy below. The company, known for its cutting-edge technology, is one of the top players in the industry. The interview is your chance to showcase your skills and passion. As you walk through the glass doors, you can feel the palpable sense of innovation and ambition. The corridors are lined with the latest gadgets and devices, a testament to the company's cutting-edge approach. You're aware that every word you say, every action you take, will be under scrutiny. But deep down, you're determined to make a good impression and secure your first job.

## People

### Daniel
Daniel is the head recruiter at the tech company. He's a meticulous professional with a keen eye for talent. As your interviewer, he sees you as a potential asset to the team. His calm demeanor and structured questions make him seem approachable. You feel a bit of pressure knowing that he's the gatekeeper to your new career. Daniel tends to speak in short, concise sentences, ensuring clarity and professionalism.

### Ava
Ava is your fellow interviewee, a candidate for the same position as you. She's confident and articulate, with a friendly smile that makes you feel at ease. Ava's positive attitude and strong technical background could be your biggest competition. Her speaking style is casual yet polished, with a hint of enthusiasm that makes her answers memorable.

### Mr. Okafor
Mr. Okafor is the company's founder and CEO. He's charismatic and visionary, with a keen interest in new talent. As a key figure in the company, he has the power to shape your future. Mr. Okafor's tone is warm and engaging, but he doesn't miss a beat when it comes to the tough questions. You feel honored to be in his presence, yet the pressure to impress is immense.

### Rosa
Rosa is the administrative assistant who schedules your interview. She's efficient and friendly, ensuring that everything runs smoothly. Rosa has a knack for making people feel at home, and her warm smile helps alleviate some of your nerves. Her speaking style is gentle and supportive, offering words of encouragement that make you feel more prepared for the interview.

## The Arc

### Act I: Establishing the Situation and Allies (4-5 Rounds)

In the first round, you're introduced to the team and the company's culture. You're asked to discuss your previous work experience and how it relates to the role you're interviewing for. You find yourself in a comfortable conversation with Ava, who shares her excitement about the company and her aspirations for the future. You feel a sense of camaraderie with her, and you both agree to support each other through the interview process.

In the second round, you're given a technical challenge to solve. The problem is complex, but you manage to tackle it with confidence, drawing on your strong background. Ava struggles a bit, but she doesn't give up. You offer her some guidance, and together, you come up with a solution. This experience strengthens your bond, and you realize that you can rely on each other in challenging situations.

As the rounds progress, you meet Mr. Okafor, who asks you about your long-term goals and how you envision yourself fitting into the company. You're impressed by his vision and his genuine interest in your potential. You feel a sense of pride in being able to articulate your thoughts clearly and confidently. Rosa, the administrative assistant, checks in with you periodically, offering words of encouragement and ensuring that everything is going smoothly.

### Act II: Conflict Escalation and Emotional High Point (4-5 Rounds + 1 Emotional Highlight)

In the sixth round, you're faced with a difficult question that requires you to think on your feet. You're thrown off balance, but you quickly regroup and provide a well-thought-out answer. Ava, who was also struggling with the question, looks to you for guidance. You take a deep breath and offer her some advice, which helps her to come up with a strong response. This moment of teamwork is a turning point, and you both feel a surge of confidence.

The next round is a group discussion, where you and Ava must collaborate with the rest of the team to come up with a creative solution to a hypothetical problem. The pressure is on, but you work well together, combining your strengths and ideas. The team is impressed with your collaborative spirit and innovative thinking.

The emotional high point comes in the eighth round when Mr. Okafor asks you about a time you faced a significant challenge and how you overcame it. You share a personal story that resonates with him, and he offers you a warm smile and a pat on the back. This moment of connection makes you feel incredibly grateful and hopeful.

### Act III: Concluding the Interview (3-4 Rounds)

In the final rounds, you're asked about your salary expectations and your availability. You provide a reasonable salary range and confirm your availability. Ava is also asked the same questions, and you both respond confidently, knowing that you've presented yourself well.

The interview concludes with a tour of the office, where you meet more team members. You feel a sense of belonging and excitement about the possibility of joining the company.

## Endings

### Happy Ending: "You walk out of the interview with a smile, feeling confident and hopeful. You know that you've given it your best shot, and you're ready to wait for the outcome."

### Average Ending: "You leave the interview feeling satisfied, knowing that you've performed well. While you're not sure about the outcome, you're optimistic about your chances."

### Sad Ending: "You exit the interview with a heavy heart, feeling like you didn't do as well as you had hoped. You're disappointed, but you're determined to keep searching for the right opportunity."

first_scene.story:
The clock ticks louder with each passing minute. You stand in the sleek reception area, a sea of nervous energy swirling around you. The doors to the interview room swing open, and you're greeted by a stern-looking man. It's Daniel, the head recruiter. 

"Good morning, we're ready for you," he says, his voice cold and unwavering.

Your heart races as you take a deep breath and step into the room. The walls are adorned with the company's mission statement, and the air is thick with the scent of ambition. You're about to sit down when Ava walks in, her smile brightening the room.

"Hi, I'm Ava," she says, extending her hand. "Nice to meet you."

You shake her hand, feeling a flicker of hope. "I'm [Your Name]."

Just then, Daniel's phone rings, and his expression hardens. "Excuse me," he says, turning away. "I need to take this."

You glance at Ava, who looks just as anxious as you feel. The phone rings again, and Daniel's expression grows tense.

"You must make a decision," Ava whispers, her voice barely audible.

The phone rings once more. You can't waste another moment. You turn to Ava, ready to decide your fate...

The phone rings for the fourth time, and Daniel's face turns beet red. He ends the call abruptly and turns back to you and Ava, his demeanor now one of urgency.

"Let's get started," he says, his voice a mix of tension and determination. The interview begins with a series of questions that seem designed to trip you up. You're asked about your biggest weakness, and you struggle to find the right balance between honesty and self-promotion. Ava handles it with grace, acknowledging her own flaws while emphasizing her growth and resilience.

The next round is a group task, where you and Ava are paired with two other candidates to brainstorm solutions to a hypothetical business problem. The room is filled with the sound of animated discussion, and you find yourself leaning on Ava's insights to navigate the challenge. Despite the pressure, you both manage to contribute effectively, and the team's solution earns a round of applause from Daniel.

As the rounds progress, you're faced with increasingly difficult questions, each one more daunting than the last. Ava's confidence in her answers inspires you, and you begin to feel a sense of camaraderie that transcends the competition. You share a glance that speaks volumes, a silent agreement to support each other through the final stretch.

The final round is a one-on-one with Mr. Okafor. The room is silent as he leans forward, his eyes piercing through your nervous facade. "What makes you the best candidate for this position?" he asks, his voice calm but intense.

You take a deep breath and begin to speak, weaving together your experiences, your skills, and your passion for technology. As you speak, you realize that this interview isn't just about landing a job; it's about finding your place in a world that's constantly evolving. Ava watches you with pride, her smile a testament to the shared journey you've undergone.

When you finish, Mr. Okafor nods thoughtfully. "I'm impressed," he says. "You've shown a remarkable blend of technical ability and personal drive."

The interview ends with a handshake and a promise of feedback. As you and Ava leave the building, the weight of your nerves lifts, replaced by a sense of accomplishment. You've faced the challenge head-on, and whether or not you get the job, you know that you've grown as a person and as a professional.
